candidateMechanisms.observation: Refused (FLAT) post-mask hall flashes: r01b win 4/42 with no back-to-back pair, r03 win 3/42 with none, r02 death 13/30 with back-to-back pairs ending at cycles 8, 16, 22 and 28; Foxy struck in cycle 29. candidateMechanisms.candidate: A hall flash refused after a defended encounter leaves Withered Foxy un-reset; two refusals in a row let him reach the office. The Night 5 encounter census (2026-09-12) recorded the same consequence (dark or refused flash after a defended encounter; only post-encounter FLAT flashes leave Foxy un-reset) and that the model has the encounter frequency but not this consequence. That would explain k2 winning all 65,536 seeds in the model while the phone loses.

modelTest-hallFlashSlide.mechanismInCode: plant-model.js onFiveSecond evaluates Foxy's roll 21 + Random(0..4) - D <= 17 on the 5 s grid from night start: at epoch 2433 that is 2.567 and 7.567 s into every cycle. The hall flash zeroes D and pins him for FOXY_HALL_PIN_FRAMES = 50; a flash that lands after the 7.567 s roll leaves ten seconds of D and he locks.
modelTest-hallFlashSlide.reading: A hall flash pressed up to 7540 ms still stops the roll; at 7560 ms every seed dies to Foxy. k2 plans 7460 ms, so one flash whose effect lands ~90 ms late kills in that cycle. The register prices the release at effective epoch 2410-2445 ms including the hall light's measured 47-82 ms latency, leaving ~55-70 ms to the Foxy edge at 2500 ms. The phone's four deaths (cycles 1, 20, 22, 29; ~4 in ~200 exposed cycles, ~2%/cycle) all show Foxy first visible at 7.29-7.73 s, around the 7.567 s roll.
modelTest-hallFlashSlide.status: CANDIDATE mechanism consistent with all four deaths and the model cliff; not yet a finding
modelTest-hallFlashSlide.nextTest: delay only the hall-flash rows through schedule({shift}) with a per-cycle latency tail and find the tail beyond the cliff that reproduces a ~2%/cycle hazard; an earlier flash is a new binding and a new cohort, never a change inside this one

modelTest-cliffAcrossEpoch.rule: epoch + hallOffsetMs + the flash's effect latency must land before ~9983 ms of night time, one frame ahead of Foxy's 10 000 ms roll; k2 plans 2433 + 7460 = 9893 ms, 90 ms of slack at the aim and less at later delivered epochs
